$comment: Class-specific pilot built from the Bigfoot rig contract. The base limb/body parts are byte-for-byte copies of assets/characters/bigfoot/sworn/parts; purpose-drawn Thornguard torso, chest, and pauldron layers are added. Chest and lower torso share the body bone but sit on opposite sides of the arms in z-order, preserving both the inner shoulder fit and the hands. The armored head is a deterministic face-plus-brown-mane extraction from the base head/mane layers so pale shoulder fur cannot punch holes through the cuirass. Each pauldron follows its matching arm.
